presets.name: No menu circle
presets.description: Hides the circular button background. Other buttons that share this circle artwork also lose their background; their icons and click areas remain.

presets.name: No grey panels (minimap)
presets.description: Hides the grey square behind the minimap and the shared rounded panel artwork used behind MASS and other menu panels. Text, map markers and click areas remain. This affects shared panels, not just the minimap.

presets.name: No in-game toolbar
presets.description: Hides this toolbar artwork on phone and PC where available. The button can still be clicked; keyboard shortcuts and gameplay are unchanged.
